water_losses.title: Water losses: which metered zones get pressure management
water_losses.question: Yanabi can fit pressure-reducing valves in 12 of 60 metered zones this year. Each valve costs SAR 150,000 and is expected to cut night-flow losses by 20%. Water lost costs SAR 4 per cubic metre. Which zones, and what is the expected saving and its uncertainty?
water_losses.decision: 12 zones out of 60, or fewer if the expected saving does not cover the cost

school_inspections.title: School inspections: which schools get a follow-up visit
school_inspections.question: An inspectorate can make 30 follow-up visits. A visit costs SAR 9,000; a serious finding left unaddressed for a year is valued at SAR 4,000. Which schools, and how sure are you about the small schools with one visit on record?

clinic_waits.title: Clinic waiting times: where an extra doctor goes
clinic_waits.question: A health cluster can add one doctor to each of 5 clinics out of 40. The target is a median wait under 30 minutes. Which clinics, and what is the probability that each one meets the target after the change?
